snippet.title: Titanic Films by Mark
snippet.description:
This channel preserves the history of the world’s great ocean liners, with the RMS Titanic at its core.
Along with Titanic and her Olympic-class sisters, I cover the iconic ships that defined the golden age of transatlantic travel, including RMS Queen Mary, RMS Lusitania, RMS Mauretania, SS United States, and other famous ocean liners.
Each film is created from restored photographs, rare footage, archival documents, engineering records, and firsthand accounts to present clear and authentic maritime history. My goal is to keep these ships and their stories alive with accuracy, respect, and a deep appreciation for the people and the era they represent.
If you enjoy these documentaries, please subscribe here on YouTube, like, and comment to support the channel.
You can also follow and support my work on:
• Dailymotion: https://www.dailymotion.com/user/TitanicDocsbyMark
• Facebook: facebook.com/TitanicFilmsByMark
Jesus loves you and died for you; you only have to believe in Him. John 3:16

snippet.title: National Geographic
snippet.description:
Step into wonder and find your inner explorer with National Geographic. 

National Geographic is the world's premium destination for science, exploration, and adventure. Welcome to the National Geographic community, where we bring our stories, images and video to the world in real-time, inviting followers along on our ongoing 138-year journey. Our yellow border is a portal to the world, showcasing all of the wonder and beauty that it has to offer. This page allows our fans to join us while promoting an enriching and supportive climate for our community. Therefore, we do not tolerate words of hate, harassment or disparagement. We reserve the right to remove any posting or other material that we find off-topic, inappropriate or objectionable.

Subscribe to films and podcasts, featuring leading critics, artists, thinkers, and curators, presenting and celebrating thought-provoking content about art history. 

A non-profit organisation, HENI Talks aims to inspire and educate through talks on painting, sculpture, architecture, photography, and design. 

Covering art movements, artists, and in-depth analyses of artworks, HENI Talks collaborates with cultural institutions, experts, and artists worldwide. 

You’re welcome to link to, embed, or share these films
